text.text_excerpt: Definitely a great choice for your supplement needs. Always have competitive pricing and sales going on. Plus, their free membership program is well worth it Only downside is service. Sometimes the staff isn't that friendly, so they may not speak to you as you walk in the store or ask if there is anything you need. Thought it was just a one time thing but continues to happen to myself and other friends who come to this place. I prefer to be left alone while shopping anyway, but would be nice to feel a little more welcomed. Regardless, the sales keep me coming back.

Needed to find some supplements and ran a check on YELP for a place in Uptown New Orleans. This was my first visit and I was looking for something I was not familiar with or had purchased in the past. Walked in and was immediately approached and assisted. Very nice professional and friendly staff in this business. Large variety of products and the business is clean and the AC works well. Street parking and this business is in a section of Magazine St. where I had no problem parking. Will return for any future vitamin and supplement needs. May also take the advice of Shannon S. and check out their web site.

If you're looking for health supplements in New Orleans, this is your stop! Product: Health supplements on a grand scale---vitamins (of course), flax seed oil, homeopathic remedies (if that's your thing), workout supplements, protein powder, and nutritionally-dense snacks and drinks. The prices here are more than reasonable. (5 stars) Service: There are usually at least 2 employees working. They work interchangeably between the floor, stocking, and cash register. I've always found them to be friendly, well-informed, and efficient in their service, if a little pushy about upselling. (4 stars) Facilities: The business shares the building it is in with Pizza Domenica (that's a story for anot...
